central_claim: President Biden has signed a proclamation officially establishing a national monument in honor of Emmett Till and his mother, Mamie Till-Mobley.
intended_effect: To inform viewers of a significant presidential action related to civil rights history and to generate a positive perception of the Biden administration's commitment to honoring that history.
